entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I have a jersey that I need to return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Got it, thank you. I see the order for the Pro-Series Cycling Jersey. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's a preference thing. I bought it and just never got around to trying it on until now. It's the wrong size for me, it's just a bit too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping to do an exchange for a larger size.

I understand. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered 61 days ago. And since this is a standard jersey, it falls well within our 90-day return policy. We can absolutely get that return processed for you. I'm generating a prepaid return label to send to your email now.

That's great news, I appreciate you making that easy. Now, since I'm going to place a new order for the correct size anyway, and considering I'm a long-time customer, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my trouble?

Let me see what I can do. I see you're a VIP member with us and we definitely value your business. I'm happy to add a 15% off coupon directly to your account. It will be automatically applied at checkout on your next order. How does that sound?
That's perfect, Charlie. A 15% discount works for me. Thank you for being so helpful and understanding.
You're very welcome. The return label is on its way to your inbox, and the discount is active on your account. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
